The background is filled with shelving units, brown storage boxes labeled 'THOR', and blurred figures of other shoppers walking through the aisles. (2) The presenter demonstrates the unfolding mechanism of the silver frame, stretching the legs outward to reveal its structural integrity. The lighting is bright and overhead, casting soft shadows on the floor. He then transitions to a black version of the same frame. He picks up a wooden tabletop with a hexagonal engraved pattern and demonstrates how it rests securely on the legs. A small black cylindrical lantern is shown being inserted into a pre-drilled hole in the wooden board. (3) The man shifts his focus to a tall, slender silver metal clothing rack standing on the floor. He hangs a grey textile organizer bag from one of the hooks. The camera maintains a handheld eye-level perspective, occasionally zooming in slightly on his hands as he interacts with the metal joints. Yellow subtitles and social media comment overlays are visible at the bottom of the frame throughout the demonstration. (4) In the final phase, the presenter disassembles a portion of the silver rack to highlight the internal elastic tension cord that holds the segments together. He holds the metal joint close to the camera, showing its smooth, polished finish and lack of sharp edges. The store environment remains busy but orderly, with warm interior lighting reflecting off the metallic surfaces of the products.
